messages:
Nora (sec-eng): Heads-up: after the RBAC tighten on region-keystore we're seeing intermittent mTLS handshakes fail between services in eu-west-2.
Ben (infra): Can you paste a short log sample?
Nora (sec-eng): Proxy snippet: ```
2026-04-11T09:12:07Z proxy-eu-west tls: unwrap error: KMS AccessDenied principal=role/rotator-role key=alias/region-keystore
```
Kai (sre): I see a 40s spike of 502s svc-events -> svc-ingest around that time. Canary nodes hit first.
AuditBot: Alert ID KMS-20260411-9: 22 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/rotator-role between 2026-04-11T09:11:50Z and 2026-04-11T09:12:20Z. Archive: /logs/sec/kms/2026-04-11/KMS-20260411-9.json
Ben (infra): Immediate mitigation: patch via infra pipeline to grant kms:Decrypt to service-account/proxy-fanout for alias/region-keystore for 20m, and increase proxy cache TTL to 5m on canary. No console edits.
Kai (sre): Running emergency job: `./infra/iam-emergency --grant "proxy-fanout:kms:Decrypt:alias/region-keystore" --duration 20m --tag incident-mtls-euw2`
DeployBot: Job j-8801 started by Kai (sre). Logs: /ci/jobs/j-8801/logs
Kai (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/5, cache TTL bumped. Error rate returned to baseline within ~30s. No more KMS denies after regrant.
Nora (sec-eng): Postmortem items: (1) add RBAC preflight that simulates KMS decrypt as rotator principal, (2) default proxy cache TTL -> 3m, (3) rotator fallback to cached chain + circuit-breaker on decrypt failure, (4) retain KMS deny logs 90d.
Ben (infra): I'll open infra PR for the preflight check and IAM gating. Suggest adding rollout gate: fail canary if KMS Deny > 0 for 1m.
Kai (sre): Agree. I'll add an observability assertion and a CI fault-injection test that returns KMS Deny for rotator path.
Nora (sec-eng): I'll own the postmortem doc and link SEC-4902. Thanks all. Closing unless new alerts. :lock:
